parts.tooltip: fmap f :: (a, w1) ⟶ ((b, w2), w1)\nApplies f to the value; the outer log w1 stays where it is, the new log w2 sits inside.
join :: ((b, w2), w1) ⟶ (b, w1<>w2) — the Writer-specific part\nMerges the outer and inner log with the monoid append, in execution order: w1 first, then w2.

ports.tooltip: (a, w1) — a result value a paired with a log fragment w1
f : a ⟶ (b, w2) — user code; given a, produces result b alongside a new log fragment w2
(b, w1<>w2) — result b with the complete log: w1 from the first step appended with w2 from f
